name: neo-andean
title: Neo-Andean
description: Ceremonial, identity-forward — painted concrete, woven textiles, sacred geometry. Color in blocks, not gradients; brights paired with very dark bases; saturation as architectural weight; gold + magenta carry ceremonial authority. Corpus: neo_andean_ceremonial_palette_2026-04-03 + the hermes theme/skin mapping (the one prior real-UI application).

family.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

notes.remap_2026-08-29: Keeper-dispatched rebuild: the first cut copied the GC/diadem role hues wholesale and rendered as a visual no-op. This mapping is drawn from the ceremonial palette's own annotations: structure = Solar Gold #FFC857 (the palette labels it 'Ceremonial focus' — a direct match for the structure/focus role; gold carries architectural authority, and the hermes mapping put gold on primary, midground AND label); info = Glacial Cyan #66E6FF; stability = Highland Lime ('Vitality / success'); threshold = Copper Earth #C46A2D (the burnished earthen gate — keeping gold free for structure keeps threshold visually distinct from it); violation = Ceremonial Red ('Alerts / breach channel', never decorative); intent = Festival Magenta ('Active energy', the hermes accent).
notes.honest_overlaps: stability, violation, and intent share hexes with governed-cognition because diadem's cockpit inherited this very palette through odysseus — the overlap is lineage, not laziness. Distinctness now comes from the gold-structural chrome (vs GC's teal), the icier info channel, the copper threshold, and the vendored Oxanium/Rajdhani actually rendering.
notes.muted: muted #8A6A4F and muted-alt #6b5340 are dim earthen values (the second a derived darker tint, marked derived) — the hermes TUI used Copper Earth for muted, but copper now carries threshold, and the doctrine (threshold rare and consequential) forbids sharing it with everyday muted text.
notes.line: surface.line stays Andean Turquoise #00B3A4 — hermes border/ring verbatim ('Structural highlight' in the palette); focus/emphasis is gold, hairlines are turquoise.

Sky plateau rather than glacial cyan #66E6FF keeps the value off this theme's info role and off harness.opencode, so the new dot collides with nothing already on screen; the default theme takes the glacial cyan instead, so the two cockpit themes stay distinguishable at the dot. notes.derivation: LANE-DRAFTED, KEEPER-TUNABLE — the other half of the pair (keeper 2026-10-01: "they are forced dark mode or light mode, I want to make the pairs for them please"). Every value is DERIVED from this theme's own native value for the same token, by one rule applied to all seven themes, never picked: hue held (OKLCH h) and chroma held where sRGB allows; only lightness moves. Roles keep their native WEIGHT — the native contrast against the native bg is carried onto the new bg by a monotone log map (3.5:1 -> 3.0:1, 15:1 -> 8.5:1), so a role that read brighter than its sibling still reads heavier than it, and same-hue pairs stay apart by lightness; floors 4.5:1 for the text-bearing roles (info, violation, intent) and 3:1 for the rest. Categorical sets are rescaled as a WHOLE (native lightness order and log-spacing kept, fitted into the new band on the new panel) — distinctness is their meaning, so a set is never floored member by member; a member that wears a role's colour natively wears that role's colour in this half too, so native identities survive the flip. A last pass pushes the closest pair apart in lightness until each group is at least as separated as its native (OKLab dE x100, capped at 10). Text tokens sit in bands per ground (light: fg-soft 6-9:1, muted 5-7:1, muted-alt 3.5-5:1 — a light ground gives thin type no bloom). An rgba hairline keeps its native EFFECTIVE contrast over its own ground (alpha solved, never copied), floored at 1.45:1 so a line reads as a line. Surfaces keep each surface's own hue. On light they sit on johannah's attested paper ladder (lightness AND a chroma ceiling per surface), so a tinted theme becomes tinted paper, not white; the first draft's near-white ladder was the keeper's 'they revert to a default' (2026-10-01). On dark, chroma stays low so the substrate tints. Shape, motion, type and webfonts are the theme's own in both schemes — that is what makes the two halves one theme.
notes.separation: Minimum pairwise OKLab dE x100 per group, this half vs native: roles 10.4 (native 12.7); ai-usage.harness 12.9 (native 18.3); ai-usage.series-rank 6.0 (native 5.8); diadem.session-type 14.1 (native 16.9). Every group is at least as separated as its native (or at the dE 10 cap).
notes.surfaces: fg 12.98:1 on bg, 14.14:1 on panel; muted 5.02:1; muted-alt 3.51:1. fg is the native PANEL #1a2233 — the dark substrate turned into ink; a light panel sits lighter than the bg and panel-raised lighter still, johannah's attested paper ladder.
notes.background: NONE yet. The native art is a low-contrast night photograph: washed toward this ground it turned to grey fog at every strength tried (55/68/80%, and contrast-stretched or levels-brightened first, 2026-10-01). A light plate for this half would be a new asset, put to the keeper. generate.py ships it when assets-src/neo-andean/background.light.<ext> appears.
notes.theme: type on this ground, MEASURED (2026-10-01): neo-andean sets body copy in Rajdhani 400 at 12px. On a 1x screen its strokes are thinner than a pixel, so glyphs antialias toward the light ground and never reach their colour: with fg-soft at 9.0:1 the darkest rendered stroke pixel reached ~6.6:1 and most of each stroke rendered lighter (pale tan to the eye). At 2x and 3x the strokes reach the token colour. Pushing fg-soft to 12.5:1 was tried and moved the rendered strokes almost nothing — coverage, not colour, is the limit — so it was reverted. The fix is a heavier body weight (or size) on light, which is a type-axis decision, and the type axis is shared by both halves: KEEPER ITEM. On the dark half the same strokes bloom and read fine.
